note: Recast from Rocha & Cancello (2009), original in English; the original records the alate as Unknown; the original combination Capritermes orthognathus Silvestri, 1903 is given in the original and is not listed separately here.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier has stout mandibles and a head capsule larger than in O. brevipilosus, O. longilamina, O. macrocephalus and O. okeyma, with parallel sides of the head in dorsal view (slightly convergent anteriorly in O. insignis and O. uncimandibularis); the most similar species is O. heberi, whose soldier has narrower mandibles.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Sides of the head parallel in dorsal view. Dorsal tubercle slightly prominent in lateral view, situated behind the lateral projection. Mandibles type 2, with a tooth-like process on the proximal half. Head capsule sparsely setose and with short hairs, denser ventrally, minute hairs scattered over the whole head capsule and denser in the apical region. Postmentum with setae and short hairs. Pronotum with short hairs and setae, more numerous on the margins; posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum with setae and short hairs; abdominal tergites and sternites densely setose, the posterior margin of the sternites with erect setae.
